name: paradox
description: PARADOX — daily ethical dilemma debate platform

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:verify
scripts.build:verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const idx=p.resolve('client/dist/index.html');if(!fs.existsSync(idx)){console.error('[build:verify] MISSING '+idx);process.exit(1);}const assets=p.resolve('client/dist/assets');const n=fs.existsSync(assets)?fs.readdirSync(assets).length:0;if(n===0){console.error('[build:verify] client/dist/assets is empty');process.exit(1);}console.log('[build:verify] ok — client/dist/index.html present, '+n+' files in assets/');"
